purpose: Regional densify for Magic and Necromancy combat BiS: high-end staff/wand chains, power and tank armour materials, Kerapac residual progression, Death Skull residual upgrades, Rasial gear, and style-critical accessories. Skips ids already present in data/research/regional-combat-unlocks.json (notably mage-arena:guthix-staff).

policy.region_rule: required_regions means every listed region contributes a mandatory base-game acquisition step. region_hints means the chain touches those regions but may have alternatives or unresolved League overrides.
policy.league_rule: Wiki Equilibrium League region badges on boss/item pages are preferred over geography alone when they disagree. Quest auto-completion and League passives are overlays — do not erase underlying item or boss geography.
policy.combat_method_rule: Support items are surfaced when they materially change Magic or Necromancy methods. Runic attuner is skilling-only and is intentionally omitted. Vestments of havoc are melee and are intentionally omitted.
policy.duplicate_rule: Do not re-emit mage-arena:guthix-staff / Claws of Guthix. Greater Concentrated Blast is separate Kerapac residual content and is included.

equipment_additions.name: Fractured Staff of Armadyl
requirements: 95 Magic
95 Crafting to assemble (irreversible)
Kerapac, the bound hard mode for the three fractured pieces
unlocks: Surging Storm passive (+15–25% critical strike damage)
effects: Tier 95 two-handed Magic staff; common Magic BiS staff before Masterwork / Shard of Genesis Essence upgrades
Instability special costs 50% adrenaline with a 60s cooldown and grants 30s of Lightning Surge on Magic critical hits
equipment_additions.notes: Wiki tags Kerapac league_region Misthalin (Nodon Front / EGWD Senntisten). Hard mode is mandatory for FSoA pieces; normal mode does not drop them. Skip Guthix staff (already catalogued as mage-arena:guthix-staff).
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Misthalin is the working Senntisten/EGWD region and matches the wiki Equilibrium badge. Keep quest gates (Desperate Measures etc.) as overlays rather than second elective regions.

equipment_additions.name: Kerapac Magic residual progression
equipment_additions.category: Magic ability codex gloves and scripture residual
requirements: Kerapac, the bound (normal or hard mode) for non-FSoA uniques
unlocks: Kerapac's wrist wraps (t85 Magic power gloves; Combust / Dragon Breath boost)
Scripture of Jas and Manuscript of Jas pages
effects: Greater Concentrated Blast is a core Magic basic upgrade used with FSoA / dual-wield crit setups
Wrist wraps are a strong mid-to-high Magic glove option and appear in many FSoA crit stacks
Scripture of Jas is a high-end pocket-slot Magic damage book
equipment_additions.notes: Residual Magic value from Kerapac even when a planner already tracks FSoA hard-mode pieces. GConc is not covered by mage-arena:guthix-staff.

equipment_additions.name: Tectonic robe armour
requirements: 91–93 Runecrafting for mask / bottom / top
Tectonic energy from Vorago
Stones of binding (Wizards' Guild or Bandit Duty Free)
unlocks: Fracture Point critical-strike set passive (post-2025 power armour update)
effects: Tier 90 Magic power armour built from Vorago tectonic energy
Base set for elite tectonic upgrades

equipment_additions.name: Elite tectonic robe armour
equipment_additions.category: Magic best-in-slot power armour cross-region chain
requirements: Asgarnia: tectonic armour pieces and tectonic energy (Vorago)
Asgarnia: Virtus equipment broken into Praesulic essence (magic) at a dragonkin anvil (Nex/GWD Virtus)
Forinthry: draconic energy (Dragonkin Laboratory / Black Stone Dragon / ED chests)
Forinthry: chaotic remnant from Daemonheim Rewards (untradeable)
91–93 Runecrafting and stones of binding
unlocks: Elite tectonic mask / robe top / robe bottom
Elite Fracture Point: +2% critical strike chance per piece worn
effects: Tier 92 Magic power armour; standard high-end Magic armour before Tumeken's resplendence
Core FSoA crit-stack armour alongside Biting / channelled basics
equipment_additions.notes: True multi-region no-trade chain: Vorago tectonic + Virtus/praesulic are Asgarnia; draconic energy and chaotic remnant are Forinthry/Daemonheim. Do not collapse to Asgarnia-only.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Display Asgarnia + Forinthry as both required for a self-sufficient elite tectonic craft.

equipment_additions.name: Inquisitor staff
requirements: 80 Magic to wield
93 Runecrafting (boostable) to assemble
114 Archaeology (boostable) for the praetorian staff component path
Kharid-et Dig Site inquisitor staff pieces and praetorian staff materials
unlocks: Inquisitor staff (t80 with Dark Wither passive)
Optional Enchantment of affliction upgrade (+12.5% → +17.5% damage vs melee-classed)
effects: +12.5% damage and +10% hit chance against melee-classed enemies (up to +17.5% damage with enchantment)
+5 affinity when using the correct elemental spell weakness
Effective damage tiers in the mid-90s to ~105 against melee bosses despite t80 base
equipment_additions.notes: Self-sufficient acquisition is Desert Archaeology at Kharid-et (wiki lists Desert Equilibrium badge on praetorian remains hotspots). Extremely strong Magic niche staff for melee-classed bosses; not a general replacement for FSoA.

equipment_additions.name: Death guard and Skull lantern residual progression
requirements: Kili Row completion for upgrade tutorials
Soul forge in the City of Um
